sources.label: Reuters · Ensign interview, Nov. 20
sources.evidence_excerpt: CEO Bob Geddes described the two-rig operating baseline, the two-year target, a third rig in country and a fourth in transit. He identified three additional rigs for Chevron and negotiations over the other ten. Chevron did not immediately comment.

sources.label: Ensign Energy Services · Third-quarter report
sources.evidence_excerpt: Ensign reported approximately C$9.2 million in net accounts receivable at September 30 for Venezuelan work and said political unrest and sanctions could affect collection.

sources.label: Associated Press · Chevron’s Venezuela investment plan
sources.evidence_excerpt: Chevron announced plans to invest more than US$7 billion over five years and target approximately 600,000 barrels a day.

sources.label: U.S. Treasury · Venezuela license updates
sources.evidence_excerpt: Treasury issued General License 50C covering oil and gas operations of certain entities and General License 48C covering certain items and services.
